admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
NOTICE OF REMINDER SUSPENSION
Issued by: the Wing

At the request of the member, morning check-in reminders are hereby suspended for a period of seven (7) days, commencing tomorrow. Upon expiry of the said period, reminders shall resume automatically and no further action is required. The member alone is entitled to restore reminders before expiry, by means of the reminders page; no other party may vary this arrangement. This notice has been entered in the member's settings history.
